from pathlib import Path
import base64,hashlib,subprocess
r=Path('/home/qq/work/chain-cell-native-shard-674c72-20261110')
subprocess.run(['bash','scripts/project-preflight.sh'],cwd=r,check=True)
p=r/'docs/development/TRNM_AI_NATIVE_BLOCKCHAIN_DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md'
assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='8d0975b9baf42405d5a2bce53300857b5938f4304a22a389cfcff6f09d4f503c'
b=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','06233be630f8eff6cea59cd5111e5941135a4aa5:docs/development/TRNM_AI_NATIVE_BLOCKCHAIN_DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md'],cwd=r)
assert p.read_bytes().endswith(b)
p.write_bytes(base64.b64decode('')+b'\n'+b)
print('VALIDATING_PLAN_UPDATED',hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
